lines.text: و هرچند بیداید از افتاب دورتر شود چنانکه صبح او را رافع اصبح پیشتر یابند تا باز که برباط اعظم
lines.en: And however much it appears to become further from the Sun, such that its morning [rising] is found earlier than the morning [rising] of the Sun, until again it reaches the greatest depression,

lines.text: و حد تشریق رسد پس اعالي تدویر منتقل شود و بحالت اوّل عود کند و اهل احکام تشریق کوکب
lines.en: and reaches the limit of eastern elongation, then it transfers to the upper parts of the epicycle and returns to the first state. And the astrologers consider the eastern elongation of a planet

lines.text: علوي و کوکب تغریب سفلي را از جمله قوي ايشان دانند امّا فيه اغلب بحيث است که گاه باشد
lines.en: superior and the western elongation of an inferior planet to be among their strengths. But in this, it is mostly such that sometimes it happens

lines.text: که عطارد بعد از احتراق وسط رجعت اگرچه او را در مشرق باید ظاهر شود ظاهر نشود هرچند
lines.en: that Mercury, after the combustion of the middle of retrogradation, even though it should appear in the east, does not appear, however much

lines.text: برباط اعظم رسیده باشد و همچنان مخفي نماند تا احتراق دیگر بسبب انکه در بروج کوتاه مطالع
lines.en: it has reached the greatest depression, and it does not remain hidden until another combustion, because in the signs of short ascension,

lines.text: پس از اقبل از احتراق وسط استقامت در اینجهت خفا نیز باشد چه تحقیق خفا بعد از ظهور
lines.en: then from before the combustion of the middle of direct motion in this direction, there is also concealment, because the verification of concealment after appearance

lines.text: بود ایضا گاه باشد که بعد از احتراق وسط استقامت اگرچه او را در مغرب باید ظاهر شد
lines.en: was also sometimes such that after the combustion of the middle of direct motion, even though it should have appeared in the west,

lines.text: ظاهر نشود هرچند انجا نیز برباط اعظم رسیده باشد و همچنان مخفي بماند تا احتراق دیگر
lines.en: it does not appear, however much it has also reached the greatest depression there, and it remains hidden until another combustion,

lines.text: بسبب انکه در بروج کوتاه مغارب بود پس او را قبل از احتراق وسط رجعت در اینجهت
lines.en: because it was in the signs of short descension, then for it, before the combustion of the middle of retrogradation in this direction,

lines.text: خفا نیز نباشد و زهره هم گاه بود که در اقلیم پنجم در عین احتراق مرئي باشد و آن
lines.en: there is also no concealment. And Venus also sometimes was such that in the fifth clime, it is visible exactly at combustion, and that

lines.text: وقتي بود که در برج حوت راجع باشد و عرضش شمالي پس در اینحال قبل از احتراق
lines.en: was at a time when it is retrograde in the sign of Pisces and its latitude is northern, then in this state, before combustion,

lines.text: وسط رجعت نه مخفي شده باشد در مغرب و بعد از ان احتراق نه ظاهر در مشرق و از این
lines.en: of the middle of retrogradation, it has not become hidden in the west, and after that combustion, it has not appeared in the east. And from this

lines.text: بیان ظاهر شد که قید اغلب در ظهور و خفاي وسط استقامت بجهت تخلف احوال زهره
lines.en: explanation it became apparent that the restriction of 'mostly' in the appearance and concealment of the middle of direct motion is due to the variation of the states of Venus

lines.text: و عطارد است و پس در ظهور و خفاي وسط رجعت بجهت تخلف احوال زهره و عطارد هردو
lines.en: and Mercury, and then in the appearance and concealment of the middle of retrogradation, due to the variation of the states of both Venus and Mercury.

lines.text: در تقویم ظهور و خفاي خمسه متحیّره را در میان اتّصالات کلّي با زاي روز مفروضي
lines.en: In the ephemeris, the appearance and concealment of the five wandering planets among the general aspects with the 'zay' of an assumed day

lines.text: که صباح یا شام آن کوکب اخفا یا ظهور دست دهد ثبت کنند و علامت ظهور ط
lines.en: that in the morning or evening of it, the concealment or appearance of that planet occurs, they record, and the sign of appearance is 'ta'

lines.text: باشد و از خفا خف و علامت کوکب مخفي ظاهر را ملحق بعلامت ظهور و خفا نویسند و
lines.en: and of concealment is 'khaf', and they write the sign of the hidden or appearing planet attached to the sign of appearance and concealment, and

lines.text: در بعضي تقاویم هردو را مصرح نویسند و علامت کوکب را مفرد پس اگر ظهور یا خفا شرقي
lines.en: in some ephemerides they write both explicitly and the sign of the planet singly, then if the appearance or concealment is eastern,

lines.text: باشد بالاي ان یا در یسارش حرف ق نویسند و اگر مغربي باشد حرف ب نویسند
lines.en: they write the letter 'qaf' above it or to its left, and if it is western, they write the letter 'ba'.

summary.headline: Planetary Appearance and Concealment
summary.text: Discussion of the eastern and western appearances and concealments of inferior planets, especially Mercury and Venus, in relation to combustion, retrogradation, direct motion, epicycles, elongation, latitude, and short-ascension or short-descension signs. Ephemerides record these events with abbreviated letters for appearance, concealment, the planet, and eastern or western position.
